topic: Fanning out a chat message to the recipients who are online, and storing it for those who are not.
checker_notes: Minor, does not block the case: q10's phrase 'what removes an entry' assumes a per-message pending-entry store, so a valid cursor-based design (a per-user, per-conversation last-acked seq) fits it awkwardly; rewording it to 'what marks a message as no longer pending' would keep it neutral across designs.
